$comment: What svelte-treeview takes from @keenmate/web-components-core. Checked by `npm run check:core-sync` (scripts/check-core-sync.mjs); the why + how is docs/CORE-SYNC.md. `baseline` = the core commit the local copy was last synced / reviewed against. identical = byte-for-byte (line endings / trailing whitespace aside) — any difference is drift. adapted = copied with documented local edits (see `note`) — flagged when core changed the file since `baseline`. mirror = hand-ported behaviour, no shared file — flagged when the listed core sources changed since `baseline`. After a re-sync or review, bump `baseline` to the core commit you compared against.

groups.name: logging
groups.description: Core logger (SPEC §12.1 / §12.3): createLoggers, page-wide window.components.logging, perf logger.

groups.name: environment
groups.description: Theme context (SPEC §12.10), viewport / device / breakpoints, element size, motion level (SPEC §12.16).

groups.name: helpers
groups.description: dom / global helpers the vendored modules import; animate-out = row animation (docs/PLAN-row-animation.md).

groups.name: locale
groups.description: Page-wide locale + labels (SPEC §12.24): window.components.locale.labels['svelte-treeview'] between the labels prop and the English defaults; formatLabelCallback. src/lib/core/labels.ts is the seam.

groups.name: vendored tests
groups.description: Core's unit tests for the vendored modules.
groups.note: `// @vitest-environment jsdom` docblock (this repo's vitest default is node); theme.test.ts also drops the BlissElement cases. motion.test.ts is NOT vendored (needs BlissElement) — e2e/motion-level.spec.ts covers motion.

groups.name: actions
groups.description: Clickable-item model + activation runner behind the context menu (src/lib/core/menu.ts).

groups.name: loader hook

groups.note: Reviewed 2026-11-17: register also publishes window.components.locale / .security (publishLocaleHooks, core 3912936).
